title: ai-scheme answers file
description: Schema for .scheme/config.yml, the single source of skeleton-layer settings. Mechanism-layer settings live in ai-zpd's config.toml and are not described here -- see ADR 0008.

_src_path.description: Written by Copier: where this project was generated from.

_commit.description: Written by Copier: the template version this project is at. Read by `ai-scheme status` as current_version.

project_slug.description: Repository and directory name. Lowercase, digits and hyphens.

languages.description: Language profiles to install. May be empty -- a docs-only project is a valid project.

branch_strategy.description: `main` is trunk-based. `delivery` adds a long-lived delivery branch that is never pushed to directly.

readme_primary_language.description: BCP 47 tag. Only locales committed to this template are offered.

readme_strategy.description: separate: README.md plus README.<lang>.md per locale. bilingual: one file, both languages. primary_only: no translations.

commit_locales.description: Locales whose i18n sources are committed. Must contain readme_primary_language.

release_phase.description: Governance strength. Moves forward only -- see ADR 0009.

collaboration_mode.description: Whether a second human can review and approve. Orthogonal to release_phase -- see ADR 0010.

project_visibility.description: Declared, not detected. Drives enable_pages defaults and capability degradation reporting.

enable_pages.description: Publish the decision site to GitHub Pages. Defaults to false when project_visibility is private -- see ADR 0013.

enable_academic_docs.description: Install the academic writing, citation and literature review guides.

citation_style.description: Only meaningful when enable_academic_docs is true.

academic_field.description: Only meaningful when enable_academic_docs is true.
